environment.description: Rails 7.0 application deployed on EC2 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4). Session cookies use SameSite=Lax. Database connections routed through pgBouncer 1.19 in transaction pooling mode with prepared_statements disabled. Application serves both HTML pages (login/dashboard) and JSON API endpoints from the same origin. No additional request filtering or origin validation middleware. Content-Type is not enforced on the transfers endpoint.
